Show ONE clearly recognizable subject visibly performing ONLY the named action, rather than just posing. Minimal necessary context and only the essential prop for the action; no unrelated objects and no second person or animal. Entire subject and necessary props fully inside frame with ample white margin on ALL sides (at least 12 percent, subject occupying only the central 65 percent of frame). No text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermarks, including on clothing, books and screens. Books and writing/drawing supports can be blank; use at most simple non-symbolic marks. No collage or multiple panels. Correct natural anatomy, no extra limbs. School-friendly, no violence, horror or frightening expression. Vary human appearance naturally across the series; this subject's skin tone should be light. Photo children fully and ordinarily clothed. One image only; clearly teach the named subject and action.
